messages:
Nina R: dropping a fresh prototype for the prompt-sets + evals page. big picture: compact diff toggle, inline comment rail, approve flow becomes a two-step confirmation. can folks scan for copy, keyboard flow, and any dashboard layout concerns? https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/evals-v2

Carlos M: re: layout 11 the scorecard header feels top-heavy when we show tags + filters. suggest collapsing tags under a chevron by default and surface the failing count more prominently.

Priya S: copy: the approve modal currently says 'Approve changes' 11 could be read as 'commit and rollout'. propose: Title: 'Mark prompt sets as approved' Body: 'This marks selected prompt sets as approved. It does not start any rollout.' Primary CTA: 'Mark as approved' Secondary: 'Cancel'

Ethan V: accessibility notes from quick audit:
 - danger button contrast is 3.7 on our token --color-danger-600; needs >=4.5.
 - modal doesn't set aria-hidden on background, so screen readers still read behind it.
 - diff summary needs role="status" or aria-live to be announced when diffs refresh.

Maya D: small UX ask: bulk-check behavior is surprising. in the mock the checkboxes auto-select when you land in bulk mode. users expect no auto-select and an explicit 'Select all' control.

Priya S: +1 on explicit select all. also suggest per-test CTA labels be explicit: change 'Approve' -> 'Mark test approved' and 'Reject' -> 'Request changes' to reduce ambiguity.

Carlos M: for multiline prompt diffs, side-by-side helps readability. make side-by-side the default for strings >1 line and add an 'Inline' compact toggle for power users. add a small eye icon to switch.

UXBot: automated run results:
 - color-token --color-danger-600 contrast ratio 3.7 (WCAG AA fail).
 - modal: background not aria-hidden; tab sequence includes behind-page elements (tabindex not trapped).
 - diff-list: missing accessible names for test badges.
 Actions: update token or use outline/border, apply aria-hidden to main content behind modal, apply focus-trap on open.

Ethan V: implementation note: we should use focus-trap library and call trap.activate() on open and trap.deactivate() on close, plus store previous activeElement to restore focus.

Maya D: visual nits: the regression badge color currently uses the danger token but small text on colored badge is low-contrast. either increase font-weight or add stroke/background.

Priya S: propose aria-label for badge e.g. aria-label="3 failing tests" and a visually-hidden desc for screen readers that links to the failing tests list.

Carlos M: layout change request: when in regression-only view, hide neutral/green scorecards to avoid noisy scrolling. add a sticky filter bar so actions are always in view.

Nina R: ok owners and due dates:
 - modal copy + two-step flow (remove implicit rollout): owner Priya S 1 due: Tue
 - fix danger token or badge contrast: owner Maya D 1 due: Mon
 - add aria-hidden on background + focus-trap: owner Ethan V 1 due: Mon
 - change bulk-select behavior + explicit 'Select all' control: owner Carlos M 1 due: Wed
 - default side-by-side for multiline + inline toggle: owner Carlos M and dev pairing 1 spike 3d
 - failing-count badge aria-label + screen-reader hint: owner Priya S 1 due: Tue

Ethan V: I'll add unit tests for focus behavior and a small E2E for bulk selection.

Maya D: will propose updated tokens in a PR with token names and examples (e.g., --color-danger-700, --badge-text-contrast) so theme maps correctly.

Priya S: final tiny copy nits: change header 'Regression Overview' -> 'Regression summary' and change button tooltip 'Approve all' -> 'Mark all selected as approved'.

Nina R: thanks everyone. plan: merge only after UXBot passes on contrast and focus issues. let's demo the changes Friday morning.
